Welcome to my creative space

Hi, I'm Nithyasri, a 2026 Computer Science and Engineering graduate with a curious mind and a creative soul.

I'm passionate about conceptual art, doodling, digital poster design, poetry and self-love journaling. I love learning new things, documenting my journey and expressing ideas through art, writing and presentations.

This portfolio reflects my creativity, curiosity, learning and growth.

Origami

Origami turns simple paper into something beautiful through folding, patience and imagination. I make colourful paper flowers by hand, and every fold carries a bit of the joy of making.

Miniature

Miniature DIY art means making tiny, detailed versions of real places and objects by hand. I turn ordinary materials into little rooms, shops and gardens.

Cute flower shop

Keep growing. Bloom. Positivity.

Tiny signs, paper bouquets, a green bicycle and two little elephants fill this heart-shaped shop. The messages on the walls are the point: small reminders to stay positive.

Doodle

Doodling is how I let imagination flow through simple lines, shapes and playful characters. Every doodle is a small reflection of my thoughts and emotions.

Thematic art

A blend of abstract and geometric art. Here is each page of this painting and what it means to me.

Proudly my artwork

The eye of becoming

A creation I proudly made from my own vision. A blend of abstract and geometric art, born from my wildest dreams.

Page 1

Overall look of my painting

The full painting on the easel, seen from three angles: a butterfly and an eye held together by bold geometric shapes.

Page 2

Theme of butterfly wings

I created the wings using bold shades of teal blue, dark teal and red-orange. These butterfly wings symbolise that it’s never too late to start again. Your time will come.

Page 3

Theme of eye

In my artwork, the eye reflects self-love, seeing myself clearly and embracing who I am.

Page 4

Theme of star

My biggest achievement: the version of me I’ve grown into.

Page 5

Theme of chess pattern

Checkmate to self-doubt. The chess pattern in the corner of the eye is my way of winning the game against my own fears.

Page 6

Geometric pattern theme

Everything about you, big or small, creates your individuality and uniqueness.

Thematic art 2

Being unstoppable

A lion in bold colours, stripes and dots. The theme of this painting is being unstoppable.
